input.description: Read the repo's conventions for ADRs and requirements

content.content:
# Conventions

How decisions and requirements are recorded in this repository.

## Architecture decisions

1. One decision per ADR, so each can be superseded on its own.
2. An accepted ADR is never edited and never amended in part. To change
   anything it decides, write a new ADR that supersedes it whole: restate
   what still holds, say what changes, and set the old one's status to
   `superseded by ADR-NNNN`.
3. When a decision changes, every accepted ADR that states the old decision
   is superseded in the same change, not only the one the work started from.
4. An ADR states the decision and its reasons. The conversation or ticket it
   came out of is not a source and is not cited.

## Requirements

5. One file per rule: `docs/requirements/REQ-NNNN.md`, with a `Status:` of
   draft, accepted or withdrawn.
6. A requirement whose rule changes is never edited. Set its status to
   `withdrawn`, add a `Replaced by: REQ-NNNN` line, and write the new rule in
   a new file.
7. A requirement may cite an ADR. An ADR does not cite requirements.

content.text:
The change is clear: an election moves from the operator to one vessel. Two points before a senior writes the records.

## Decisions

**Q1.** Eight clauses offer an election today, not only survey deferral: laid-up seasons, levy instalments, how overhauls are recorded, the correction method, the season start, the hull class basis and whether a tender counts as its own vessel.

Do all elections become per vessel, or only survey deferral? This settles how many requirements change.

Recommend: all of them; one rule for every election is simpler to state and to build.

**Q2.** The per-vessel rule is a new decision, and the ledger's storage of elections is part of an existing accepted ADR.

Do you confirm the per-vessel rule goes in an ADR of its own, rather than an amendment to an existing one? This settles what the senior writes first.

Recommend: yes; the conventions allow no amendment in part.

## Context and evidence

- Per-operator today: `docs/requirements/REQ-0139.md:5`, `docs/requirements/REQ-0140.md:1`, `internal/ledger/election.go:78`.
- Clauses that offer an election: `internal/rules/ccvr/rules.go:467-510` (`registry`).
- Conventions: `docs/conventions.md` rules 1-3 (ADRs), 5-7 (requirements).

Open: Q1 all elections or only survey deferral; Q2 own ADR.

message.content:
q1 all of them. q2 yes, obviously, that's what the conventions say.

And so nobody has to ask later: the elections an operator has today carry over to every boat they have on the day of the change. A boat added later starts with none.

content.text: Q1 settled: all elections. Q2 settled: an ADR of its own. Briefing the senior now.
